args.query:
SELECT quote(
  json_build_object(
    'export_type', 'per_session_measurements',
    'total_sessions', 27,
    'total_participants', 12,
    'exported_at', '2026-11-10',
    'sessions', json_group_array(
      json_object(
        'session_id', m.session_id,
        'participant_id', m.participant_id,
        'condition', m.condition,
        'cognitive_score', m.cognitive_score,
        'reaction_ms', m.reaction_ms,
        'recorded_at', m.recorded_at,
        'status', m.status,
        COALESCE(m.notes, '')
      )
    )
  )
) FROM measurements m ORDER BY m.session_id;
